scope_note: General food-education examples only. Seasonal availability varies by region, climate, culture, allergies, and individual health needs. These examples are not treatment advice.

seasons.flavor: Sour (traditional five-flavor association; not a dietary prescription)
foods_to_limit: Foods that trigger a known allergy or intolerance
Highly processed foods when they displace a varied diet
seasons.lifestyle_advice: Choose a varied eating pattern that fits local seasonal availability and personal needs. There is no need to use seasonal foods as a cleanse or treatment.
seasons.source_note: Foods are general seasonal examples, not claims of TCM therapeutic effects. Organ and flavor labels describe traditional associations. This draft has not been checked against a cited seasonal materia-dietetica source; expert review required.
